verdict.rationale: YPOG documents cross-border venture work. It advised Langdock on relocating its registered seat to Germany with an SE holding structure (a redomiciliation) and Isembard on its German market entry, and it runs a 'Venture Deals in Germany' guide covering differences to other jurisdictions and the German FDI regime. The evidence is limited to one-line deal mentions and Germany-centric content, so full coverage of the story is not shown. Missing for 10: documented multi-jurisdiction financing rounds, named international investors in deals, detailed case studies of flips or redomiciliations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: YPOG advises Langdock on relocating its registered seat to Germany and establishing an SE holding structure
YPOG advises Isembard on its market entry into Germany
